# Rutgers University Human Resources (UHR)

> Comprehensive HR resource hub for Rutgers employees covering benefits, retirement planning, workplace equity, and employment policies.

UHR serves Rutgers University faculty and staff across all campuses, providing guidance on health insurance, pension plans, paid time off, and workplace culture initiatives. The site aggregates state and non-state employee benefit options, retirement planning resources, and employment equity compliance information.

## Key Topics

- Employee Benefits
- Health Insurance
- Retirement Planning
- PERS (Public Employees' Retirement System)
- Pension Plans
- Paid Time Off
- Open Enrollment
- Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
- Employment Equity
- Workplace Culture
- FlexWork@RU
- Tax Savings Plans
- Caregiver Support
- Wellness Programs
- HR Policies

## Core Benefits Programs

- [Benefits Overview](https://uhr.rutgers.edu/benefits/home): Overview of Rutgers employee benefits including health, retirement, and wellness programs
- [Health Benefits](https://uhr.rutgers.edu/benefits/health-benefits): State health plans, medical coverage, and prescription drug benefits for employees
- [Pension Plans](https://uhr.rutgers.edu/benefits/pension): Pension plans including PERS, PFRS, and ABP for Rutgers employees
- [Open Enrollment](https://uhr.rutgers.edu/benefits/open-enrollment): Annual benefits enrollment period and health plan selection for Rutgers employees
- [Life and Insurance Programs](https://uhr.rutgers.edu/benefits/life-and-insurance-programs): Life insurance and disability coverage options for Rutgers employees
- [Non-State Benefits](https://uhr.rutgers.edu/benefits/non-state-benefits-rutgers-positions): Non-state employee benefits including ABP Plan, childcare, and wellness programs
- [Tax Savings Plans](https://uhr.rutgers.edu/benefits/tax-savings-plans): Tax-deferred annuities, HSAs, and commuter benefits for Rutgers employees

## Retirement & Financial Planning

- [Retirement Planning](https://uhr.rutgers.edu/benefits/retirement): Retirement planning resources and benefits for prospective and current retirees
- [Benefit Seminars](https://uhr.rutgers.edu/benefits/benefit-seminars): Educational seminars on retirement planning, PERS, and financial planning for employees

## Employee Wellness & Support

- [Employee Assistance Program](https://uhr.rutgers.edu/eap/home): Lyra Health mental health support and counseling services for Rutgers employees
- [Caregiver Support Program](https://uhr.rutgers.edu/benefits/care-giver-support-program): Care.com backup childcare and adult care support services for Rutgers employees
- [Office of Workplace Culture](https://uhr.rutgers.edu/workplace-culture/home): Workplace culture, employee assistance, and HR policy resources at Rutgers

## Time Off & Work Arrangements

- [Paid Time Off](https://uhr.rutgers.edu/benefits/paid-time-off): Vacation, sick leave, and time-off policies for Rutgers and RBHS employees
- [FlexWork@RU Program Guidelines](https://uhr.rutgers.edu/future-of-work/flexwork-pilot-program-guidelines): Guidelines for FlexWork@RU remote and hybrid work arrangements at Rutgers
- [University Holiday and Closings Schedule](https://uhr.rutgers.edu/hr-professional/university-holiday-and-closings-schedule): Rutgers University holiday schedule and campus closings for 2025-2026

## Employment Equity & Compliance

- [Office of Employment Equity](https://uhr.rutgers.edu/oee/home): Title IX, discrimination prevention, and workplace equity compliance at Rutgers
- [Employee Rights and Employer Responsibilities](https://uhr.rutgers.edu/hr-professional/employee-rights-and-responsibilities): Labor law compliance and workplace rights information for Rutgers employees

## Employment Status & Transitions

- [Change in Employment Status](https://uhr.rutgers.edu/benefits/change-employment-status): Guide for faculty and staff transitions between employment classifications
